Prototype 1 encodes REM (100% pure) primarily through EEG (62%), with EOG (37%) and EMG (1%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows suppressed δ (-1.9 dB, sensitivity=18.2) and elevated γ (+1.2 dB, sensitivity=8.5).
The δ activity is present in 7% of each epoch (transient), with quiescent eye movements (REM 3% active) and intermediate muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with REM physiology: confirmed: EOG dominant, θ elevated; missing: EMG atonic. Note: model primarily uses δ, atypical for REM.
